# L4.4 — Crate rename `hh-*` → `hharness-*` (scripted mechanical sweep) + the rename-mechanics ADR (ADR-0379)

Ticket: `docs/tickets/164s_L4.4__crate-rename-hharness.md` · seq 164s · base `svitali/harnessharness-l4.3` · stacked on #189.

## Summary

The workspace-wide crate rename, landed as one deterministic scripted sweep
ahead of the publish dry-run: every publishable `hh-<x>` package becomes
`hharness-<x>` and the umbrella package is `hharness`; Rust library
identifiers follow (`hh_<x>` → `hharness_<x>`). Everything the ticket froze
stays byte-faithful — crate directories keep `crates/hh-*` (append-only
provenance), all 20 binary names keep their contract spellings (`hh`,
`hh-kernel`, `hh-helper`, `hh-web`, `hh-mcp-serve`, `hh-codegen`,
`hh-xcheck`, packaged-variant bins), and every wire/schema/product
identifier is preserved (`hh-embed/1`, `hh-kernel/<ver>`, `hh-helper/1`,
`hh-xcheck-bundle/1`, `hh://`, the `hh/` registry namespace, `_hh/`
methods, `hh.*` telemetry attributes, `HH_*` env vars).

## crates.io availability — the binding pre-mutation check

One `GET https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/<name>` per target name, ≥1 s
apart, descriptive UA; 404 = free, 200 = taken, anything else = inconclusive
(stop before any file is touched). Run-time result **54/54 free**
(umbrella `hharness` + all 53 publishable `hharness-<x>` names, checked
2026-10-23T00:34:59Z–00:36:13Z — verbatim per-name output in
`docs/build/runs/L4.4.md`). The planning-time baseline agreed.

## What changed

- **`scripts/rename-crates.sh`** (new) — three phases: (1) the availability
  gate over the exact `cargo metadata --no-deps` publish set (any taken or
  inconclusive name → STOP, exit 3, zero files touched); (2) the
  deterministic context-aware sweep — TOML `[package]` names, dependency
  keys and feature references, `use`/`..hh_x::` paths, `-p`/`--package`
  positions for collision names, scripts/workflows/docs prose — under a
  protection grammar for directories, binaries, contract ids, path/realm/
  log spellings; (3) regeneration (Cargo.lock metadata, `hh-codegen`
  artifacts, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, `cargo fmt`). `--check-only`,
  `--no-check` (documented re-run), `--no-regen` (fixture roots) modes;
  idempotent no-op on an already-renamed tree.
- **`scripts/ci/test-rename-crates.sh`** (new) — fixture workspace +
  stubbed availability endpoint; four legs: taken → exit 3 byte-identical;
  inconclusive 5xx → exit 3 byte-identical; all-404 → full rename with
  every protected surface verified; rerun → no-op.
- **The sweep** — 975 files, +16,224/−14,996 lines (mechanical, exempt):
  manifests, dep keys, features, Rust `use`/path positions, scripts,
  workflows, codegen inputs, living docs, `Cargo.lock`.
- **OQ-068 `_meta` conform** (per ADR-0210's allocation record):
  `dev.cognition/hir|propagation|input_required` → `hharness/*`; ACP
  `_meta.hh` vendor member → `_meta.hharness` (member tuple + accessors +
  `.get`/`.get_mut`/`.insert` spellings).
- **Generated artifacts regenerated** by `hh-codegen` (CC7 — never
  hand-edited): `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json`,
  `schema/plugin-abi-1.schema.json`, `schema/compat-1.matrix.json`,
  `crates/hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs`,
  `clients/ts/hh-embed.ts`. The only semantic delta: `owner_layer`
  `hh-embed` → `hharness-embed` (the field names the crate) plus the
  honest `schema_hash` roll carried by the matrix + TS
  `EXPECTED_SCHEMA_HASH`.
- **`docs/adr/ADR-0379`** — the rename-mechanics ADR: the mapping, the
  directory-preservation decision, the binary/contract freeze set, the
  availability-gate protocol, the OQ-068 conform, regeneration and
  verification behavior. `docs/adr/README.md` index regenerated by the
  tooling.
- **`scripts/check-removability.sh`** — pre-existing defect fixed: the
  extension-tier/adapter allow-lists still omitted R4.7's
  `hh-github-issues` (same dep shape as `hh-tracker-fixture`); the rename
  surfaced it because the allow-list spelled package names.

## Preserved (byte-frozen, audited)

Directories `crates/hh-*`/`plugins/hh-*`; all 20 binary names; `HH_*`
env vars; `hh-embed/1`, `hh-kernel/<ver>`, `hh-helper/1`,
`hh-xcheck-bundle/1`, `hh-bundle:<ver>` log/identity spellings,
`hh-embed:fleet` holder names, `otel.service:hh-bundle`,
`realm="hh-lab"/"hh-mcp"` OAuth values; `hh://` URIs; `hh/` + `_hh/`
namespaces; `hh.*` attribute/tracestate keys; `docs/build/`,
`docs/tickets/`, `docs/adr/` (except +ADR-0379/index), `research/`,
`spec/`, `spikes/` untouched — append-only history preserved.

## Sweep corrections found by verification (fixed in the script, re-swept)

TOML `section=None` crash; apostrophe-path matcher removed (prose
apostrophes); `..hh_x::` struct-update paths; `:`/`.`-bounded contract
tokens (`hh-x:<ver>`, `x:hh-y`, `file.hh-z`); `.join("hh-x")` path-API
arguments; `realm="hh-x"` contexts; NUL-guarded source handled under the
same rules (`crates/hh-fleet/src/identity.rs`).

## Deviation — non-mechanical budget

The ticket caps non-mechanical lines at 400 (script + ADR + docs). Actual:
~900 (`rename-crates.sh` 368 + self-test 217 + ADR 134 + run ledger +
~70 lines of hand fixes). The protection grammar grew as real defect
classes surfaced through verification; **surfaced for operator ruling**
rather than split or silently claimed — the mechanical sweep itself is
exempt per the ticket.
